caption: The drawing depicts three distinct objects on a light beige background contained within a thin rectangular border. The main object, located centrally in the lower half of the page, is a black wrought-iron-looking door handle mounted on an irregularly shaped dark metal plate. The plate features a twisted handle, a starburst or floral cutout pattern, a visible screw, and the initials “I S” at the bottom right. Near the upper left corner, there is a scaled line drawing of the same plate and handle, outlined in pencil with a simple decorative border and additional stylized details, including radiating lines around the handle, the initials “I S,” and a small scale bar underneath. At the top right, there is a drawing of a single L-shaped nail or metal peg with a round head partially inserted into a surface, oriented more horizontally than the other objects. The drawing is completed in shades of black, white, and gray pencil, with all objects meticulously outlined and shaded for depth and texture. The name "Francis Law Durand" is inscribed at the bottom right outside the border.
title: Latch Plate
